hero.sub: Built for psychologists, therapists, and personal-development coaches. No site to build, no tools to wire up. We run the checkout, the classroom, and your payouts. You teach.
hero.trust1Desc: Every program on the marketplace goes through Skillset review.
hero.trust2Desc: Multi-currency checkout in 30+ currencies via Stripe.
hero.trust3Desc: Every certificate has a public verification URL.

how.title: Three steps from your method to a published program.
how.step1Desc: Open a Teacher Studio account, accept the Teacher Terms, connect Stripe Express. Free, takes minutes.
how.step2Desc: Build your modules and lessons in Course Builder. Set your price and a free preview lesson. Submit.
how.step3Desc: Your course goes live the moment you submit. Skillset's review runs alongside, so nothing holds up your first enrollment. Get paid in 30+ currencies, with earnings clearing {days} days after each sale.

marketplace.title: Reviewed courses, ready to learn.
marketplace.sub: Every course is built by an independent expert and reviewed by Skillset, across psychology, management, health, and professional skills.

capabilities.title: Everything your program needs is already built in.
capabilities.sub: No add-ons. No locked features. Every plan ships the same toolset. Your plan only changes the commission you pay per sale.
capabilities.c1Desc: Modular structure, multiple lesson types, scheduled events, a free preview slot.
capabilities.c2Desc: Release lessons by progress or on a schedule, and protect your work during the refund window.
capabilities.c3Desc: Every paid course gets a private space for posts, replies, and likes. Members keep talking there after the lesson ends.
capabilities.c4Desc: Sell in 30+ currencies. Learners pay in their own currency at checkout.
capabilities.c5Desc: Earnings move from pending to available {days} days after each sale. Full ledger, full audit trail.
capabilities.c6Desc: A public link anyone can check in seconds. Proof your members did the work.

promise.title: Six commitments. Written down. Public.
promise.sub: Skillset puts what it owes creators in a contract anyone can read. Fees locked. Data portable. Cancel anytime. Read it before you sign up.
promise.cardSub: Six commitments to every creator, in writing.
promise.p1Desc: Your commission rate at signup is yours for two years. No surprise hikes after you've built a business here.
promise.p2Desc: Export every course, student, sale, and post as a ZIP in one click. Whenever. No questions asked.
promise.p3Desc: Delete your account in one click. No retention emails, no support runaround, no friction.

creators.title: Reach more people than your practice ever could.
creators.bullet1: Keep {keep}% on Free. Scale to Plus and your commission can drop to 0%.
creators.bullet2: Payouts clear {days} days after each sale. No subscription needed to start.
creators.bullet3: Drip release and a refund window protect you from abuse.
creators.bullet4: Course community, live sessions, and verifiable certificates on every plan.
